note: Empty space below the content, per screen, as a ceiling. §2 of docs/ui-revamp-plan.md wants ≤25% of a 1440x900 viewport empty below the last element on every screen; these screens are still above it. Filling them is content work, not a stylesheet change — the seeded review workspace holds three customers, two bookings, one checklist and no suppliers or refunds, so the screens that list those are short by data, not by layout — and it belongs to those screens' own phase (§4: 'inline empty states, real content density, and a what-to-do-next action'). The ceiling may not rise: a screen above its recorded figure fails the metrics gate. Measured values below the ceiling are reported so the entry can be deleted as soon as the screen meets the 25% target.
slackNote: The gate allows two points of measurement slack for viewport rounding before calling a ceiling breached. That is noise tolerance, not permission to regress.
